name: causal-powers
description: Superpowers for data analytics, causal inference, and econometrics — discipline skills that make the silent failures of data work loud (the clean run that hands you a confident, wrong answer). R, Julia, Python.

interface.shortDescription: Rigor for data analysis, causal inference & econometrics — make silent failures loud
interface.longDescription: Guides analytical work through question framing, data preparation, data contracts, pre-analysis plans, causal identification, structural estimation, bounded robust execution, and verification — catching the silent bugs that run clean and hand you a confident, wrong answer. Reduced-form and structural workflows for R, Julia, and Python.
defaultPrompt: Help me frame this analysis before I touch the data.
Clean and build the dataset for this study, then plan the estimation.
